usages.usage: 《furnished》 with 表示房子或空間被配備、布置好需要的東西
examples: I am renting a new **apartment**, and it needs to be 《furnished》 with all of the **essentials** it needs, the things we don't even __think about__!

usages.familiarMeaning: do 的過去分詞，表示做了
usages.usage: be done 表示事情已經完成
find it + adjective 表示覺得某事是某種狀態
examples: I know! Everybody is so shocked when I tell them I can't drive, but in Mexico, I just never 《found》 it very necessary.

usages.usage: seem to + V 表示某人或某事似乎會做某動作
examples: They're super important, but we 《seem》 to forget about them because I think they're a little bit boring; **nevertheless**, they are very important.

usages.usage: 作動詞時，head home 表示往家裡去、回家
examples: You're at the **grocery** store shopping for **essentials**, and you 《head》 home, and then you realize, "Ugh, I forgot again."

usages.usage: 在網路或社群平台上發布內容
examples: Don't forget to **subscribe** and __turn on__ the bell **notifications** so you can be **notified** every time I 《post》 a new video.

breakdowns.sentence: I have just come back from the grocery store.

points.label: 現在完成式（have/has + p.p.）
points.text: 主詞 + have/has + just + 過去分詞
points.note: 用來表示剛完成的動作，並且和現在的狀態有關。

breakdowns.sentence: It needs to be furnished with all of the essentials it needs.
breakdowns.translation: 它需要配齊所有需要的必需品。

points.label: need + to be + 過去分詞
points.text: 主詞 + needs + to be + past participle
points.note: 公寓是被布置、被配備的對象，所以用 to be furnished 表示被動。

breakdowns.sentence: So, I did some grocery shopping for the essentials that my kitchen needs first.
breakdowns.translation: 所以，我先去買了一些廚房需要的必需品。

points.label: 關係子句 that + 主詞 + 動詞
points.text: 名詞 + that + 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: that my kitchen needs 用來補充說明 essentials 是哪一些必需品。

breakdowns.sentence: I don't have a car, and even if I did, I don't know how to drive.
breakdowns.translation: 我沒有車，而且就算我有車，我也不知道怎麼開車。

points.label: even if 條件子句與助動詞替代
points.text: even if + 主詞 + did, 主詞 + 動詞
points.note: did 代替前面的 had a car，用簡短方式表示假設情況。

breakdowns.sentence: Anything can really be cooked in this pan.
breakdowns.translation: 任何東西其實都可以用這個鍋子煮。

points.label: 情態助動詞被動語態
points.text: 情態助動詞 can + be + 過去分詞
points.note: 焦點在東西被煮，而不是誰煮，所以用被動語態。

breakdowns.sentence: It's wide enough and deep enough.

points.label: 形容詞 + enough
points.note: enough 修飾形容詞時放在形容詞後面，表示程度足夠。

breakdowns.sentence: As I was walking home, I realized I forgot to buy a dustpan.
breakdowns.translation: 我走回家的時候，才發現我忘了買畚斗。

points.label: 過去進行式時間子句
points.text: As/While + 主詞 + was/were + V-ing, 主詞 + 過去式動詞
points.note: 用過去進行式描述當時正在發生的背景動作，再接另一個發生的動作。

breakdowns.sentence: Let me know in the comments what else you can peel!
breakdowns.translation: 請在留言區告訴我，你還可以削什麼！

points.label: 間接問句語序
points.text: 疑問詞 + 主詞 + 助動詞 + 原形動詞
points.note: what else you can peel 是嵌入在句子裡的問題，所以用 you can，不用 can you。

breakdowns.sentence: This is my first time living alone.

points.label: This is my first time + V-ing
points.text: This is + 所有格 + first time + V-ing
points.note: 用來表示某人第一次做某件事或有某種經驗。

breakdowns.sentence: I'm going to be buying lots of essentials that I never had to buy before.
breakdowns.translation: 我會買很多以前從來不需要自己買的必需品。

points.label: be going to be + V-ing（未來進行）
points.text: 主詞 + be going to + be + V-ing
points.note: 表示未來一段時間會持續或反覆進行的動作。

breakdowns.sentence: Turn on the bell notifications so you can be notified every time I post a new video.
breakdowns.translation: 開啟鈴鐺通知，這樣每次我發布新影片時，你都能收到通知。

points.label: so + can + 被動語態
points.text: so + 主詞 + can + be + 過去分詞
points.note: so 引出目的或結果；can be notified 表示你能被通知。
